title: The worker stopped reporting
summary: No metrics from the worker for 10 minutes: it's stuck or down (c logs worker), or its metrics can't reach Grafana Cloud (otlp.env). The other app alerts can't see anything until it's back.

title: The API is failing requests
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} requests answered with a server error (5xx) in the last 10 minutes. The API dashboard lists them; each opens its trace.

title: The API is slow
summary: For 10 minutes, the slowest 5% of API requests have taken over {{ humanizeDuration $values.A.Value }}. The API dashboard shows which routes.

title: A source keeps failing
expr: (sum by (server_address) (increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"sports-follow-(api|worker)", error_type!="", error_type!~"4.."}[10m])) / sum by (server_address) (increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"sports-follow-(api|worker)"}[10m]))) and on (server_address) sum by (server_address) (increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"sports-follow-(api|worker)", error_type!="", error_type!~"4.."}[10m])) >= 5
summary: For 5 minutes, over half the requests to {{ $labels.server_address }} have failed with a server error or no answer at all. Its scores and pages go stale. The Sources dashboard has its errors and warnings.

title: A source keeps telling us to slow down
summary: {{ $labels.source }} has had us paused (it answered 429) for over half of the last 15 minutes: live scores from it are late. Check its plan and the requests by lane on the Sources dashboard.

title: A source's allowance is nearly used
expr: max by (source, bucket, window) (sports_follow_source_used{job="sports-follow-worker"}) / on (source, window) group_left max by (source, window) (sports_follow_source_allowance{job="sports-follow-worker"})
summary: {{ $labels.source }} {{ $labels.bucket }}: {{ humanizePercentage $values.A.Value }} of this {{ $labels.window }}'s allowance is used. Background refreshes have stopped; live games and fans get the rest.

title: A source says its allowance is nearly gone
expr: min by (source, bucket) (sports_follow_source_left{job="sports-follow-worker"}) / on (source) group_left max by (source) (sports_follow_source_allowance{job="sports-follow-worker", window="hour"})
summary: {{ $labels.source }} {{ $labels.bucket }} says under {{ humanizePercentage $values.A.Value }} of its hourly allowance is left: another key or app may be using it too.

title: A live game isn't being polled
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} {{ $labels.source }} game(s) haven't been polled for three of their rounds (at least 3 minutes): their scores and alerts are late. The Jobs dashboard shows the queue and the worker's warnings. A game its source has stopped returning (a fixture outside the plan, say) stays behind, and this mails every 6 hours, until the game is closed 6 days after its start.

title: Jobs are waiting for the worker
summary: For 5 minutes, a job has waited over 2 minutes for one of the worker's slots: polls, builds and pushes queue behind it. The Jobs dashboard shows what's running.

title: Pushes aren't going out
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} moment(s) found over 3 minutes ago haven't been sent, and the tick's sweep hasn't sent them either. Fans aren't getting alerts: c logs worker.

title: Pushes are failing
summary: {{ humanizePercentage $values.A.Value }} of pushes in the last 30 minutes failed (not counting unsubscribed devices). The Notifications dashboard shows which push service and status.

title: Player pages keep failing to build
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} player pages failed to build in the last hour: fans see an error on them. The model gateway or a source may be down; the worker's warnings say.

title: Player refreshes keep failing
expr: (sum(increase(sports_follow_cards_updates_total{job=~"sports-follow-(api|worker)", step="refresh", result="failed"}[1h])) / sum(increase(sports_follow_cards_updates_total{job=~"sports-follow-(api|worker)", step="refresh"}[1h]))) and on () sum(increase(sports_follow_cards_updates_total{job=~"sports-follow-(api|worker)", step="refresh", result="failed"}[1h])) >= 5
summary: Over half of player refreshes failed in the last hour ({{ humanizePercentage $values.A.Value }}): fixtures and stats go stale. A source is likely down; see the Sources dashboard.

title: Someone signed in to the admin panel
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} sign-in(s) to the admin panel in the last 5 minutes (another within these 5 minutes sends no email of its own). If it wasn't you, set a new password and code at once (deploy/README.md, "The admin panel"): that signs every admin out.

title: Someone is guessing at the admin sign-in
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} wrong admin passwords or codes in the last hour. At 30 the sign-in stops taking tries for the rest of the hour; deploy/README.md ("The admin panel") says how to clear that.

title: The feed has kept nothing for a day
summary: No new video about a followed player has been kept from any channel or moment search for 24 hours, so the Feed is going stale. The Feed dashboard shows where the funnel stops: no uploads read (the YouTube key or its quota; c logs curator), nothing matched (no channel covers who fans follow), or everything refused (by reason).

title: The feed's judge is failing
summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} candidates the judge couldn't answer for in the last hour ({{ $labels.kind }}): new videos stay unjudged and unserved until it answers. out_of_credit: the OpenRouter credit (or the gateway's daily budget) is spent, so top it up; timeout or unavailable: the llm-providers gateway or its provider; invalid_output: the model's answers. The Feed dashboard has the errors by kind; c logs curator has each one.

title: A sport's followed players have no videos
expr: max by (sport) (max_over_time(sports_follow_feed_covered{job="sports-follow-curator"}[1d])) == 0 and on (sport) min by (sport) (min_over_time(sports_follow_feed_followed{job="sports-follow-curator"}[1d])) > 0 and on (sport) sum by (sport) (count_over_time(sports_follow_feed_followed{job="sports-follow-curator"}[1d])) > 1200
summary: For a day, none of the players fans follow in {{ $labels.sport }} has had a video the Feed would serve (published in the last 7 days). Either no trusted channel covers them (add one to the sport's video_channels) or what's found isn't kept or passed: the Feed dashboard's funnel by sport, and the admin panel's Feed tab (each channel's yield), say which.
